newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - AOL strong buy reiterated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - AOL strong buy reiterated.

text.p: -- Alex. Brown analyst Steve Eskenazi reiterated his strong buy on America Online Inc and said he was planning to set a new target price of $65 to $75 on the stock.
-- The analyst had held a target price of $80 to $100 in early August, when the stock was trading around $30, before a sell-off in October pushed the stock to its 52-week low of a little over $22.
-- Eskenazi said he planned to revise his earnings estimates for the upcoming quarters in the coming days due to new projections made by company officials in a conference call earlier this morning.

-- However, he noted that the company's decision to change its accounting policy to immediately expense accounting costs rather than defer them as it has in the past will make earnings for the current and future quarters not directly comparable with previous quarters including AOL's first fiscal quarter ending in September.
-- AOL stock was trading at 24-3/4, up 1/8 of a point, in a rollercoaster trading session that had earlier seen the stock trading at 27, up more than two points on the day.

-- Eskenazi said he was impressed by the comprehensive restructuring plan AOL introduced earlier Tuesday and by the company's willingness to directly respond to the leading concerns of Wall Street analysts.

-- He said he was referring to plans by the company to reduce subscriber turnover, control marketing costs and present a convincing plan for sustaining membership growth as part of a restructuring effort that included pricing and organizational changes.
